name: ghost-crew
description: A night shift for browser QA. The Ghost Captain writes ghosts for the pages you name, summons them in a real Chrome, and shows you spirit photographs with every accessibility problem and broken form circled. Turn on the midnight patrol and it re-runs the crew every night and tells you only what is new and what was exorcised.
author: alex4524
highlights: Ghost Captain agent: describe a page, get ghosts written, validated and summoned
Poltergeist checks accessibility with axe-core, a keyboard walk and focus rings
Phantom Form types emoji names, markup and negative numbers into your forms
Every finding comes back circled on a screenshot of the page, numbered to match the list
Midnight patrol compares with last night and stays silent when nothing changed
Runs from the public GitHub repository with npx; no npm publish, no local checkout

crons.name: midnight-haunt
crons.message: Midnight patrol. Follow the 'Midnight patrol' section of the ghost-crew skill: summon the saved crew with last night's report as the baseline, then reply only with new hauntings and exorcisms. If nothing changed, reply with nothing.

useCases: Before a release, ask the captain to haunt your staging URL and read the séance record instead of clicking through by hand.
Leave the midnight patrol on during a redesign and wake up to a list of what broke and what got fixed.
configuration: Needs Node 20+ and Google Chrome. Tell the captain which URLs you own; it refuses to haunt anything else.
